title: E-Paper Schedule Trade Tile
oneLiner: Turn a shared household calendar into a low-power wall tile where family members trade conflicts instead of silently overwriting events.
targetUser: Families, co-parents, roommates, and multi-generational homes coordinating chores, pickups, and private time.
keyUX: Surface one conflict, let members keep, move, or trade it, propose compatible swaps, and require both people to confirm.
